key_impacts: Cases escalated, leading to a more serious local situation
Movement Control Order imposed with multiple phases
Other major events scheduled by SEADPRI-UKM in 2020 cancelled
evidence_snippets: The first case of the Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) was reported in Malaysia on 14 January 2020.
COVID-19 cases have escalated and led to a more serious situation at the local level.
The Government imposed the Movement Control Order; phases ran 18–31 Mar, 1–14 Apr, 15–28 Apr, and 29 Apr–12 May 2020.
missing_information: Exact numbers of cases and deaths

evidence_snippets: Devastating floods in the Astore River Basin in the last decade (2003, 2005, 2010 and 2011).
Resulted in a high number of human casualties and an enormous loss of property, causing immeasurable suffering.
missing_information: Specific affected settlements within the basin
